motionrow.text: Motion version: WebGL 3D hero, parallax, tilt, reveals

motionnote.text:
How the motion works
• Hero: a live WebGL scene (raymarched 3D shapes in navy, teal and mist) that orbits with your mouse. No libraries, about 3 KB.
• Parallax: hero text, floating chips and project images move at different speeds.
• Cards tilt in 3D toward the cursor.
• Sections fade and rise in on scroll; stats count up.
• Spotlight follows the cursor in the dark industries band.
• Respects "reduce motion": effects switch off and the 3D scene renders one still frame.
• SEO-safe: all text is real HTML; the canvas is decorative only.
Press Play and open full window to feel it.

creativerow.text: Built Different: kinetic, dark, one color per industry

creativenote.text:
What's in Built Different (v3)
• Type: Geist (light headlines) + Geist Mono labels. No italics.
• The page shifts color as you scroll: ink → bone → ink → navy → bone → orange → ink.
• Image marquee: two rows of project shots drifting in opposite directions, faster when you scroll.
• Liquid WebGL hero; headline lines slide up; industry word slides to the next.
• Industry rows reveal a floating image on hover; work images unmask as they enter.
• Work scrolls sideways on wide screens; grid on tablets and phones.
• Header: transparent over the hero, turns into a floating glass bar on scroll, hides on scroll down. Industries opens a mega menu; Menu opens a full-screen overlay with image previews.
Press Play, then full window.

siterow.text: Full site in the locked style: every page links to the others

sitenote.text:
How the full site works
• Every page shares the sticky header, mega menu, full-screen menu, footer and the "Message Rakib H." widget.
• Widget: shows Online (green) 10:00–23:00 Dhaka time, otherwise Away, with your local time. Opens a mini chat with topic chips; sending shows a typing reply.
• Dashed orange highlights are facts only you know, such as prices, timelines and results.
• Case study: one board for all 25 projects. Pick from the dropdown or press Next project. Cards on Work open the right one.
• All copy comes from the Phase 1 copy doc, so SEO titles and H1s match it.
